questions.stem: Why do villi have walls that are only one cell thick?

options.text: To allow them to move and mix the food
To reduce the diffusion distance so nutrients are absorbed more quickly
To make them flexible enough to stretch
To allow enzymes to pass through easily

questions.explanation: Having walls just one cell thick provides a very short diffusion distance, allowing nutrients to pass quickly from the intestine into the blood capillaries inside the villi.
